name: session-guardian
description: Keeps long sessions cheap and easy to pick up: warns before a session's cache goes cold and what coming back costs, nudges a wrap-up past a set size, holds a command that keeps failing, and adds /wrapup, which also saves the session's dead ends.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before the cache goes cold
warnMinutes.description: The main conversation stays cached for an hour after its last message. One pop-up comes this many minutes before that.

warnFromTokens.title: Only warn for sessions at least this big (tokens)
warnFromTokens.description: Smaller sessions are cheap to bring back, so they get no countdown.

wrapupAt.title: Suggest a wrap-up at this size (tokens)
wrapupAt.description: Past this, every message re-reads a lot. One nudge here, and one more at twice this size.

weeklyUsd.title: Your weekly limit in API dollars (0 = off)
weeklyUsd.description: Set it to also show costs as a share of your week. Measure it once: what a week that filled your weekly bar would have cost at API prices.

retryGuard.title: Hold a command that keeps failing
retryGuard.description: When the same command fails twice in a row with nothing changed in between, hold the next identical attempt once and ask Claude to change something first.

deadEnds.title: Save dead ends with /wrapup
deadEnds.description: Commands that failed twice in a row unchanged are listed in the /wrapup prompt, with what was seen working after them, so the saved notes warn the next session.
